about.text: The first DOP cheese of Canton Ticino, registered in 2002: a pressed, semi-hard alpine cheese made mainly from cow's milk on the alpine pastures in the alpine season, and ripened in cellars for about 60 days to a year. Young cheese is sweet and aromatic, and older cheese is sharper.

sources.text: Its history, milk, making and ageing, from the RSI article; its cellars and rind, from the rind study; its registration, from the BLW page.
